description: What the hosted Edge Stats store covers: the symbols, their session calendars, coverage windows, session counts, and when the nightly build last ran. Session statistics (how often a setup actually worked, with sample sizes and confidence intervals) come from the open-source edge-stats engine over free market data. Start here, then edge_presets for the questions you can ask, then edge_report for a result.
